user.title: NOS Teletekst
user.description: This loads the teletext card and lets Home Assistant fetch pages from the NOS. Afterwards, add the 'NOS Teletekst' card to a dashboard.

abort.already_configured: NOS Teletekst has already been added.

init.title: Which pages do you want to follow?
init.description: Each page gets a sensor. Its state is the first meaningful line; the full text sits in the attributes, ready for a notification or a voice assistant. For example 101 for news, 601 for sport, 702 for weather.

data_description.trefwoorden: Each word gets a sensor that turns on as soon as it appears on one of your followed pages. Useful for a notification about your team, your town, or any topic you follow.
data_description.verkeer: Fetches page 730 and all its subpages: jams, closures and diversions from the ANWB. Costs six extra requests per round.
data_description.wegen: Each road gets a sensor that turns on as soon as there is a report for it. For example A15, A16, N3.

error.ongeldige_pagina: One of the page numbers is not valid. Use three digits, optionally with a subpage: 101 or 100-2.

pagina_ophalen.name: Get page
pagina_ophalen.description: Fetches a teletext page as plain text.

pagina.name: Page
pagina.description: Page number, optionally with a subpage. For example 101 or 100-2.

zoeken.name: Search
zoeken.description: Searches for a word across the given pages.

paginas.name: Pages
paginas.description: The pages to search. Maximum of 30.
